scope: All plate specimens in both requested galleries, plus their linked Canadian Forces sections for France and Germany.
limits: Photographs visually inventoried; layout reconstructions are approximate, not individual glyph traces or authenticated factory tooling. Source-caption dates are distinct from website update stamps. Undated examples remain undated. Source image boxes crop photographs, not perspective-rectified or paint-segmented outlines.

presets.label: Fisheries · side renewal tabs
presets.description: Green Canada-Fisheries header and two side tabs. The source captions 1971–1972; faint tab markings are not reconstructed.

presets.description: Bilingual six-digit base. The photographed leading zero is retained; allocation limits are not documented.
